Required_Criteria: Exact sequence/chemistry; comparable monitored exposure; adequate denominator; platelet endpoint explicitly measured; no clinically relevant decline under the defined threshold; source provenance complete
Permitted_Use: Primary negative class for the same explicitly defined clinical endpoint
Prohibited_Use: Do not infer from absence of reporting, small N, short exposure, or a different platelet endpoint
Scientific_Rationale: A true negative requires demonstrated absence under conditions capable of revealing the adverse effect.

Required_Criteria: Exact sequence/chemistry and exposure; lower incidence/severity than positive anchors but one or more platelet events may occur
Prohibited_Use: Do not label as absolute safe or negative
Scientific_Rationale: Low frequency is informative but biologically different from zero demonstrated risk.

Required_Criteria: Compound may be positive for one endpoint but has zero events for a separate more severe threshold
Prohibited_Use: Do not convert to an overall negative label
Scientific_Rationale: Severity thresholds describe different outcomes and must remain distinct.

Required_Criteria: Exact sequence/chemistry; human ex vivo assay; matched conditions; low or no activation on a specific mechanistic readout
Permitted_Use: Mechanistic model control for the specified assay
Scientific_Rationale: Ex vivo low response is not equivalent to a clinical safety outcome.

Required_Criteria: Matched trial comparator with platelet monitoring and defined denominator
Permitted_Use: Estimate background incidence and treatment contrast
Prohibited_Use: Cannot provide sequence features or serve as an oligo-sequence negative
Current_Examples: Crooke pooled placebo; Witztum placebo; Benson placebo
Scientific_Rationale: Placebo is essential for causality context but is not an oligonucleotide sequence.

Required_Criteria: Platelet outcome missing, incompletely reported, or inaccessible at sequence level
Prohibited_Use: Never encode as zero or negative
Current_Examples: Most unnamed Crooke panel compounds pending supplement
Scientific_Rationale: Missingness must not be converted into biological absence.

Required_Criteria: Oligo intentionally raises/preserves platelets or modifies VWF/coagulation in a disease context
Prohibited_Use: Do not use as a thrombocytopenia-toxicity negative
Scientific_Rationale: Intended correction of disease-associated thrombocytopenia is not evidence of general platelet safety.
